visual.name: advanVisSmartDate
visual.displayName: AdvanVis - Smart Date Slicer and Calendar
visual.description: A date slicer that knows your calendar and says in plain words what is selected. Free: calendar (one to three months), timeline from years to days with bars from a measure, a presets list and a one-line compact bar, with Auto picking the layout that fits; more than 60 presets that keep rolling after you publish, counted from today or the latest date with data; viewers' own last or next N days, weeks, months, quarters or years; between, single date, on or after and on or before; fiscal years from any month, ISO week numbers and weeks from Monday, Sunday or Saturday; public holidays for 29 countries worked out offline, or your own from a field; weekends shaded and working days counted; typed dates; Apply, Clear and Reset; bookmarks, synced slicers, date hierarchies and date-time columns; tooltips and report page tooltips; six themes; full keyboard use, screen reader labels and high contrast. Pro (one-month free trial): a comparison period written to a comparison date column, working days only, retail 4-4-5, 4-5-4 and 5-4-4 calendars with 52 or 53-week years, several ranges at once and your own named presets.
